trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on v2.3.1 in all regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Attempted rollback to v2.3.0 (most recent healthy production release), but it was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to v2.2.9 — the most recent healthy, non-quarantined production release — across us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback.
